goal.text: Asher's stated goal is for the company to run 90-95% autonomously.

figure.intro: These measures follow approved work through acceptance and release, and show where agent time goes. They are not a company autonomy rate: the founder's time is not yet measured.

metrics.label: Outcomes approved October 13–26 that the founder has accepted
metrics.method: First outcome_approved per outcome from 2026-10-13 to 72 h before 2026-10-30T01:00Z; accepted = a review accept event for the same outcome before 2026-10-30T01:00Z.

metrics.label: Accepted outcomes needing a release that reached their destination within 72 hours
metrics.blurb: Merged, deployed or sent within 72 hours of acceptance. Accepted October 13–26.
metrics.method: First review accept per outcome from 2026-10-13 to 72 h before 2026-10-30T01:00Z, limited to outcomes whose accept scheduled a release; released = owner_release_done at or after the accept and within 72 h. 42 further accepts needed no release step.

metrics.label: Agent working minutes on client and product projects, October 16–30
metrics.shortLabel: Agent time on clients and products
metrics.blurb: Share of agent working time on client work and products. Last 14 days.
metrics.method: Owner-session minutes clipped to 2026-10-16T01:00Z – 2026-10-30T01:00Z; outward = client (engine) and product (bets) projects; internal = the runtime and the Lab site.
